title: Asiad: Rondina, Pons still through to next round despite loss to Kazakhs
summary: Alas Pilipinas' Sisi Rondina and Bernadeth Pons are still through to the Round of 16 in women's beach volleyball despite a 17-21, 21-10, 10-15 loss to Kazakhstan on Friday.
